Call **503-542-2717**. I’ll repeat: **5-0-3, 5-4-2, 2-7-1-7**.  
Backup number: **503-542-2389**.  
You can ask, “I’m 16 and need a safe place tonight. Can I get help without contacting my parents right away?”
